subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 10=5 Early rising is the habit of (a) _____ (get) up from bed early in the morning. An early (b) _____ (rise) can enjoy the (c) _____ (fresh) of the morning air. He can hear the (d) _____ (melody) songs of the birds. Again, he can start his day’s work(e) _____ (early) than others. An early riser does not suffer from (f) _____ (physic) problems very often. So, he need not go to any physician (g) _____ (frequent). Thus, an early (h) _____ (rise) enjoys (i) _____ (vary) benefits and leads a (j) _____ (peace) life.
guide_solution: (a) getting (b) riser (c) freshness (d) melodious (e) earlier (f) physical (g) frequently (h) riser (i) various (j) peaceful
